research_scope: Ten early/base-game skills from PQ49-PQ60. Previously researched Stone Bullet and Justice Pose are excluded because their canonical research already exists. Reward-slot and Ultimate-Finish semantics remain unresolved unless directly established.

records.name: Do or Die
records.skill_description: Temporarily reduces damage taken while pushing away nearby opponents.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies Do or Die as a Power Up Super using 100 Ki. The effect lasts 20 seconds and documents a 10% damage reduction.

records.name: Explosive Buu Buu Punch
records.skill_description: Rushes the opponent with a barrage of punches and a final knockback strike.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies it as a Strike Super using 100 Ki, with nine hits and super armor during the attack.

records.name: Burst Rush
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 51 — Great Saiyaman is Here
records.skill_description: Counters a Strike attack and follows with a rush attack.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies Burst Rush as a Strike Super counter using 100 Ki. A successful counter produces a four-hit barrage and knockdown.

records.name: Final Cannon
records.character_source: Trunks (Future); Trunks (Kid); Gotenks; Pan; Tapion; Kefla (Super Saiyan); Jiren
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 52 — Super Saiyan Bargain Sale
records.skill_description: Rushes forward with a short serial Strike attack that launches the opponent.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies Final Cannon as a Strike Super using 100 Ki. The documented sequence has six hits and launches the opponent.

records.name: Victory Cannon
records.skill_description: Fires a Ki Wave while using recoil to create distance from enemies.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies Victory Cannon as a Ki Blast Evasive using 300 stamina. It launches nearby opponents and propels the user backward.

records.name: Super Donut Volley
records.skill_description: Fires explosive Ki rings, with additional inputs allowing multiple projectiles.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies Super Donut Volley as a Ki Blast Super using 100 Ki and allows up to eight rings with additional input.

records.name: Rakshasa's Claw
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 57 — Hell Is A Picture?
records.skill_description: Launches directional sword-energy slashes and teleports to the opponent for a finishing slash.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies Rakshasa's Claw as a Strike Super using 100 Ki. Repeated inputs produce multiple slashes before a teleporting overhead attack.

records.name: Vanishing Ball
records.skill_description: Creates and throws a large tracking Ki Blast that can be charged.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies Vanishing Ball as a Ki Blast Super using 100 Ki, with nine-hit tracking behavior and charge time.

records.name: Force Shield
records.skill_description: Deploys a barrier that cancels Ki waves and can be maintained while consuming Ki.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies Force Shield as a Ki Blast Evasive using 200 stamina. Holding the input keeps the barrier active while rapidly draining Ki.

records.name: Dimension Cannon
records.character_source: Super Buu; Majin Buu (Gohan Absorbed); Janemba; Omega Shenron
records.skill_description: Fires a timespace-bending Ki Wave from the mouth that can break a guard.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies Dimension Cannon as a Ki Blast Evasive using 300 stamina, with six hits and a guard-breaking property.

records.name: Majin Kamehameha
records.character_source: Majin Buu; Super Buu; Kid Buu; Mira; Android 21; Majin CaCs
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 60 — Blast the Spirit Bomb!
records.skill_description: Fires a pink Kamehameha that can be charged through three stages.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies Majin Kamehameha as a Ki Blast Super using 100 Ki. It can be charged to three stages and has increased hit count at maximum charge.
